conclusion: 60mA memory read plus nominal20mA charge leaves no MCU margin at80mA input minimum. KISET/resistor upper screen alone exceeds80mA before MCU. Cannot promise full-rate USB sync and20mA charging simultaneously.
design_policy: Keep CHG_ALLOW low throughout USB storage ownership and recovery; only allow charging after storage is released and USB/load/battery/NTC conditions qualified. If remaining20mA MCU+USB budget fails, throttle read duty or redesign input limit with USB negotiation.
limitations: Storage60mA is datasheet3.3V50MHz condition; actual selected SPI clock current unknown
Linear power path/LDO screening uses current sums, not switching conversion
Charge upper screen excludes unspecified additional errors
BQ power-path may reduce charge or supplement from battery; do not rely on supplement until battery pulse current qualified
Host eject while still configured does not alone prove low USB consumption
implemented: Existing firmware has no charge-enable API, so charging remains inhibited. Conditional charging/resume not yet implemented.
